integrity: All formulas are supported by an explicit four-step topological proof and separately reproducible finite quotient-cell/Smith computations; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to diagonal cyclic shifts on two equally sized coordinate blocks of the real polyhedral product over the complete bipartite graph. It determines the complete integral cohomology ring, not the full fundamental group or homotopy type. Finite exact computations at n=3,4 and cell counts at n=3,4,5,6 support, but do not establish, the all-n theorem. An inaccessible primary thesis and unindexed equivalent publications remain originality risks.
title: Integral cohomology rings of diagonal cyclic quotients of real moment-angle complexes over \(K_{n,n}\)
